body:
**New game: Stellar Blade** (experimental)
- Its own look, **UE4SS** with one click (our build for the game), and **save backups** from the save folder of your Steam account.
- You find it in **See all games** in the game picker.

**Also new**
- **Mortal Shell II** and **WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers** are no longer experimental: players' feedback confirmed them.
- **Phantom Blade Zero:** the one-click UE4SS install now also works when the online list of releases cannot be reached.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.3.1.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.3.1.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
